wholePhysicalScope: Native triangulated church plan and connected monastery range footprints with modeled masonry retaining walls and river-side piers.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the trilobed church and drum, corner towers and court range at the river. Nearby views add arched openings, stone bands, buttresses and metal roof seams.
limitations: Model covers the principal church and contiguous monastery ranges on the Olt riverbank as seen in November 2009. It includes the main retained court and river supports.

Native church, range and round tower map outlines fix the plan. The church booklet fixes the drum section and the surviving images fix the silhouette. Roof junctions, parapet details, window spacing and repeating ornament are estimates.

The unmodified public terrain shows a submerged or generalized riverbank surface below the visible monastery court. Model retaining walls support the occupied level above that surface. Foundation toe and absolute grade are approximate.
